title: Polish 4/7: Doc-comment sweep B — application & backend modules, missing_docs lint
description:
### Summary
Documentation-only sweep over everything Polish-3 didn't cover: module-level `//!` docs for all remaining modules, doc comments on public types/functions in the application modules, brief "internal" banners on backend/support modules, then turn on `#![warn(missing_docs)]` in lib.rs and drive the warning count to zero. NO code changes — docs and attributes only.

### Files
- Application modules: `src/houses.rs`, `src/eclipse.rs`, `src/riseset.rs`, `src/heliacal.rs`, `src/phenomena.rs`, `src/nodaps.rs`, `src/orbit.rs`, `src/crossings.rs`, `src/azalt.rs`, `src/date.rs`, `src/stars.rs`, `src/math.rs`, `src/ayanamsa.rs`, `src/topocentric.rs`, `src/sidereal_time.rs`
- Support/backend modules: `src/calc.rs`, `src/corrections.rs`, `src/obliquity.rs`, `src/bias.rs`, `src/precession.rs`, `src/constants.rs`, `src/deltat/`, `src/nutation/`, `src/moshier/`, `src/jpl/`, `src/sweph_file/`
- `src/lib.rs` — add `#![warn(missing_docs)]`

### Implementation steps
1. **Module docs** (`//!`) for every module lacking one: 3–8 lines — what domain it covers, which C source file it ports, whether users should call it directly or go through `Ephemeris` (application modules: "the `Ephemeris::xxx` methods in `context` are the primary entry points; the free functions here are the pure cores"). Backend modules (moshier/jpl/sweph_file) and math/support modules get an explicit "Low-level internals, exposed for golden tests and advanced use" banner line.
2. **Public output types** in application modules that Polish-3 didn't touch: eclipse structs' per-field docs are the priority — each field states which C tret[i]/attr[i]/dcore[i] slot it came from (this info is already in the struct definitions' comments and docs/codebase-map.md; convert to real doc comments where it's currently `//`). Same for HeliacalPheno's 28 fields (C dret index each), VisLimitResult, OrbitalElements (17 dret slots), NodesApsides, HouseResult/AscMc, RiseSetResult, Phenomena (attr indices), MoonCrossing.
3. **Public free functions**: one-liner + units for each pub fn in math.rs/date.rs (many exist; keep terse — signature + unit note). For pure-core functions that mirror an Ephemeris method (azalt::azalt vs Ephemeris::azalt), say "pure core of [`Ephemeris::azalt`]; caller supplies precomputed ARMC/eps".
4. **`#![warn(missing_docs)]`** in lib.rs, then iterate `cargo doc` until zero missing_docs warnings. For genuinely internal pub items that are only pub for golden tests, a one-line doc ("Internal: exposed for golden differential tests.") is acceptable — do NOT weaken visibility or add #[doc(hidden)] (golden tests and downstream debugging want them findable).
5. Do not restate algorithm narratives that already live in docs/codebase-map.md or code comments — link/point instead ("see `docs/c-ref-houses.md` §7" style pointers are fine in doc comments).

### C reference
None to read. All content from existing Rust code, comments, and docs/.

### Golden tests
None. `cargo test` must stay green.

### Acceptance criteria
- `RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps` passes with `#![warn(missing_docs)]` active
- `cargo test` passes
- Every module in src/ has a `//!` header (verify: `for f in $(find src -name '*.rs'); do head -1 $f | grep -q '^//!' || echo $f; done` prints only mod.rs files whose docs live on the `pub mod` declaration, data-table files like moshier/tables.rs may carry a one-line banner)

### Escape hatch
heliacal.rs (3977 lines) and eclipse.rs (3257 lines) have many pub items. If zero-warning coverage would exceed ~600 lines of doc additions in a single file, split: fully document the public structs + Ephemeris-adjacent entry points, give the internal pub helpers the one-line "Internal:" form, and note the shortcut in the completion report. Do not stop the lint activation for it.
execution_record: Fanned out to 6 parallel Sonnet subagents (types.rs, constants.rs, heliacal.rs, sweph_file+jpl, math+error+misc, moshier+calc+houses+misc) for the bulk doc-writing work. One agent (math+error+misc) committed independently (7b93410); the rest left changes unstaged. I fixed 13 pre-existing rustdoc link errors inline (eclipse.rs, nodaps.rs, orbit.rs, phenomena.rs), added /// docs on all pub mod declarations in lib.rs, added #![warn(missing_docs)], and added //! module headers to ~16 files that lacked them. Final commit 3b55f35 covers all remaining changes. Total: 966 insertions across 41 files. No escape hatch needed — heliacal.rs's 200-line addition stayed well under the 600-line threshold.

edges.note: missing_docs lint activates only after sweep A covered the core layer
